# v1.0.11 — the 2025 benchmark becomes a pipeline step

Version 1.0.10 archived the script behind the 57.3% benchmark but filed it under `code/charls_only/`,
which by this package's convention means "needs the CHARLS release". It does not: the script reads
`out/jamda_full.rds` and nothing else, exactly like `96_stratum_bench.R` beside it. So the pipeline
never ran it, and the one figure the release existed to make reproducible stayed outside the smoke
test.

## What changed

- `code/charls_only/99_stratum_bench_2025.R` → `code/99_stratum_bench_2025.R`, and added to
  `run_all.sh` as step 55, immediately after `96_stratum_bench.R`. `run_all.sh` now has 57 steps
  (55 R scripts and 2 Python utilities).
- The closing report now depends on the cohort. On the synthetic cohort it prints a note that the
  rows are a structural smoke test and names the published values; the check itself
  (`59.5 / 67.8 / 52.1 / 57.3`, tolerance 0.2 points) fires only when the analytic cohort has
  n = 6,052. A pipeline run is therefore never mistaken for a reproduction of the manuscript.
- `manifest/outputs.csv` follows the new path.

## Two stale statements corrected

- `DATA_AVAILABILITY.md` quoted the data statement as "…are openly available at Zenodo … the version
  used here is **1.0.8**" and merged it with the code statement. The manuscript has since split the
  two and added the GitHub address, so the file now quotes both statements verbatim, including the
  GitHub address and the version that accompanies the submission.
- The Zenodo description's contents line still said "56 R scripts and three Python utilities … three
  further R scripts that need the CHARLS release". The tree has 57 R scripts, five Python utilities
  and five `charls_only` scripts; the line now says so.

## What did not change

No estimate in the manuscript changed. The script still writes
`out/99_stratum_bench_2025.csv`, byte for byte identical to the archived
`manifest/s27/JFA_stratum_bench_2025.csv` on the CHARLS cohort.

## Known remaining gap

`manifest/outputs.csv` still has no row for Tables S29-S31 and S33-S36 (scripts exist, none names the
table in its header).

Cite this version, or the concept DOI `10.5281/zenodo.23677282`, which resolves here. Versions
1.0.8, 1.0.9 and 1.0.10 remain citable at their own version DOIs.
